notes.title: The Future Of Blunder The Sea
notes.content:
[b] Cracked Games Update: The Future of Blunder The Sea [/b]

Hi all!

This is a post to discuss the future of Cracked Games. If you've been following the company's games, you've noticed our participation in a few game jams. One of these jams we submitted Blunder The Sea, and I fell in love with the game. This has become my main project and focus. We will still be participating in game jams, however, those games will most likely stay undeveloped for the time being until Blunder The Sea is at least in beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032767/462ebaab008886ff9f48c1b5dc2487cd1ab4005f.gif[/img]

Blunder The Sea is getting a complete rework. It was originally made in Godot, but I will be moving it to Unity because the version control system is better. Originally this game was a boss fight bullet hell. But it will be becoming a dungeon crawler, rogue-like, bullet hell. It will also be transferred into 3-D orthographic instead of top-down to give it a more visually appealing look.

I hope you look forward to diving in when it is released. It is currently on Steam for wishlisting, so please check it out.


Sneak Peek
Here is a sneak peek into the visual changes that are happening for Blunder The Sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032767/adcb0c74ed611d2d9cf1065ebc202d0de6803093.png[/img]

Thanks for your support!

Egg
Cracked Games
